method: SII answer-slot readout over thinking chains; q_chain = sigmoid(label logits[:K] - logsumexp over all 255 labels), averaged over chains.
notes: Raw sigmoid saturates on an untrained base head; centering by the 255-label logsumexp keeps independent per-candidate probabilities without forcing a simplex. per_chain_probs/per_chain_softmax are recorded.

Raw sigmoid on a base-model output head can saturate when every label logit is positive (CPU smoke on Qwen3.5-4B: logits 0.07..24, sigmoid ~1.0 for all options); check q_value_stats and per_chain_softmax, and use --q-transform softmax if it does.
Reasoning truncated at max_tokens is still read out; no answer text is parsed anywhere in this pipeline.
q is null only when a row has no reasoning chain at all.
